DH Joinery - Birmingham’s trusted team for bespoke joinery
DH Joinery Ltd have been providing bespoke joinery for over 20 years. No job is too big or too small. We serve customers across Birmingham. For more information, speak to a member of our team today.
Our team of skilled joiners brings years of experience and a passion for woodwork, ensuring every project meets the highest standards of quality.
We source our timber responsibly and are committed to environmentally friendly practices, ensuring our work is as sustainable as it is beautiful.
We work closely with our clients from concept to completion, providing personalized service to ensure complete satisfaction.

D H Joinery is a well-established, family-run joinery company that has built up an enviable reputation for delivering high quality bespoke joinery. From staircases to doors and windows our expert joiners can do it all. We pride ourselves on our commitment to provide a professional service at all times, whilst maintaining the highest standards of workmanship.
Windows - Sliding sash, flush fit and storm-proof.

Whether you require new window and door frames for your business premises or a new sweeping staircase for your home, our expert joiners are here to help. We offer bespoke joinery services for both residential and commercial customers across Birmingham. We are happy to work with developers and architects to provide first class joinery services.
